<!-- Public: remove anything that identifies your organisation, its people or its systems' weaknesses. -->

**Change**
The clause as it is, and as you propose it (or a new clause).

**Why**
The problem it solves, in general terms.

**Answers**
The obligation (OBL-…) or practice source (SRC-…) it rests on, if any.

**Version**
Patch (wording) / minor (new clause or sharper check) / major (changes what a clause requires, or removes one).
